tool_args.rationale: All five pilot observations are positive and have H <= 0.48. The slow-horizon probe tests whether the response reverses near H = 19.9 and constrains the slow component before confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The short-horizon rows constrain the early net gain but do not reliably separate the slow amplitude from its time constant.
Finer sampling would improve early-time resolution but would not directly test the reversal near the target horizon.
